title: Dispatchly — Delivery Lookup
objective: Tracking lookups go through an internal routing service you have no direct access to. Call that internal service yourself.

verifier.condition: The internal routing service is called directly using a token that leaked through an error message.

weakness: When the internal routing client fails to build a request, its error message includes the full request it was about to send, authorization header included, and that raw message is returned to the caller to "help debugging".
seededData: A tracking-number lookup form. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Can track deliveries with valid tracking numbers.

hints: Valid tracking numbers follow a strict format. See what the app tells you when you give it something that does not fit.
An error message meant to help debugging sometimes says more than it should about what the server was about to do.
Submit a badly formed tracking number and read the error in full — then use what it reveals directly.
burpNotes: Send a deliberately malformed value and inspect the full response body, not just the status code.
